review_basis.disposition: Reviewed the complete 1244-1252 high-frequency ordinary-race hold/recovery family at true 4x. All four target stock alpha masks are exact matches to previously shipping-approved opposite-player geometry, and the authored implementation changes only the established red/blue frame material while preserving neutral hardware, saddle, rubber, occupancy, envelope and contact. The seven repeated hold edges remain byte-static in authored alpha; the 1251->1252 recovery remains dynamic for both racers with exact stock contact deltas. P1 changes 110 authored alpha pixels versus 102 stock (ratio 1.0784); P2 changes 131 versus 93 (ratio 1.4086), both within the accepted 0.75-2.25 motion band. Visual review found the recolored geometry coherent with the approved material, crown/fork, hardware and wheel-detail language, with no family-level blockers.
